ev.q: by the sixteenth century they had disappeared from England, Wales and Scotland

1.why: A段只说到16世纪时英格兰、威尔士和苏格兰的河狸都已消失，没有比较哪里消失得更晚。看起来像 FALSE（因为三个地方放在同一句里），但原文并没有说它们同时消失，所以是 NOT GIVEN。

ev.q: a small number of beavers brought from Norway were released at Knapdale Forest

2.why: B段。brought in from abroad ↔ brought from Norway。不要和 Tay 的河狸混淆：那些是从私人饲养场逃出或被非法放生的。

ev.q: the unofficial population on the Tay was many times larger than the official one at Knapdale

3.why: B段末句。more beavers around the Tay than in the official trial area ↔ the unofficial population on the Tay was many times larger than the official one at Knapdale；By 2016 ↔ By 2016, when the Scottish government decided…。

ev.q: The government at first planned to remove them

4.why: C段。原文说政府起初计划把它们移走（at first planned to remove them），在居民抗议后才开展研究、最终允许留下，与 intended from the beginning to let … remain 矛盾，故 FALSE。

ev.q: By blocking small streams with branches and mud

5.why: D段。sticks ↔ branches；built from ↔ blocking small streams with。soil 出现在同段，但那是池塘截留的东西，不是筑坝材料。

ev.q: the highest flows further downstream were reduced by around a third

6.why: D段。in storms ↔ during heavy rain；peak flows downstream ↔ the highest flows further downstream；fall by roughly ↔ were reduced by around。

ev.q: The ponds also trap soil and farm chemicals

7.why: D段末句。hold back ↔ trap；agricultural ↔ farm（题干已给出），所以填 chemicals；water downstream is cleaner ↔ water leaving a beaver site is often cleaner。

ev.q: The animals were hunted for their fur, for their meat and for a substance produced by their glands

8.why: A段。a reason why beavers were once killed ↔ hunted for their fur, for their meat and for a substance…。F段也提到苏格兰持证捕杀河狸，但那是现在的管理手段，原因是破坏农田，且不是“曾经大量”的历史原因，是近似干扰。

ev.q: descended from animals that had escaped from private collections or had been released illegally

9.why: B段。animals that got out of captivity ↔ animals that had escaped from private collections。C段的河狸来源不明（no one knew where the animals had come from），没有说是逃出来的。

ev.q: has compared the flow of streams before and after beavers moved in

10.why: D段。a measurement of how beavers change the flow of water ↔ compared the flow of streams before and after beavers moved in … reduced by around a third。

ev.q: some anglers fear that dams stop salmon and trout from swimming upstream to breed

11.why: E段末句。people who fish ↔ anglers；a concern ↔ fear that dams stop salmon and trout…。

ev.q: a few farms on the flat land beside rivers suffer most of the damage, while the benefits

12.why: F段 Muir。some landowners are affected more than others ↔ the costs fall unevenly: a few farms on the flat land beside rivers suffer most of the damage。G段提到给受影响的农民补偿，但没有解释为什么有些人受影响更大。

ev.q: Others favour moving beavers from places where they cause trouble to rivers where they are wanted

13.why: G段。a policy of relocating animals ↔ moving beavers from places where they cause trouble to rivers where they are wanted … the preferred approach in Scotland since 2021。C段政府曾计划“移走”（remove）河狸，但那是一次性的打算，不是迁移政策。
